## 2024-05-23 - Prevent Proxy Credential Leakage in Network Logs
**Vulnerability:** Proxy credentials (passwords) were exposed in plaintext in standard output logs and raw exception traces when network connection errors occurred.
**Learning:** Passwords within proxy URLs inside exception objects generated by the `requests` library are not automatically redacted. Direct string interpolation of exceptions (`f"{e}"`) or logging proxy configuration strings leaks these credentials.
**Prevention:** Always parse sensitive configuration strings to mask passwords before logging. Use non-greedy regex sanitization (`re.sub(r'(://[^:]+:).*?(@)', r'\1***\2', str(e))`) on exception objects before writing them to logs to securely redact credentials while preserving the debugging context.
